body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an adjacent ally is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose the triggering target. It gains +1 Defense against the Action. You may spend 1 Combo to become the target instead if eligible.

surges.html: One adjacent ally also gains +1 Defense against the triggering effect.
After this Reaction resolves, move 1 unit without triggering Reactions from the triggering creature.
